source_claim: The official AIR anime cast page pairs the name Tomoko Kawakami with the character Misuzu Kamio as her performer credit. This does not establish a fictional-character HOME relation for the campaign member kawakami_tomoko.

checked_routes.result: Key's official AIR character introduction lists named in-story characters and does not list Tomoko Kawakami as a character.
TBS's official AIR cast and staff page names the cast role Misuzu Kamio: Tomoko Kawakami; the page identifies the name as the performer attached to Misuzu, not a story character.

notes: Partial campaign progress only. No character relation or negative HOME claim is asserted for kawakami_tomoko. The other six campaign identities have first-party positive evidence in the companion authority batch.
